blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines – The Department of Justice (DOJ) is assessing the sworn statement of former police officer Rodulfo Gracioso Jr., applying the legal principle of the “totality of circumstances” in ensuring that any prospective criminal charges or witness protection coverage will hold up under judicial scrutiny. Justice Secretary Fredderick Vida said the DOJ received Gracioso’s affidavit from the National Bureau of Investigation (NBI) late last week. Vida explained that the NBI and the DOJ are conducting a parallel review of the affidavit so that, if it reaches the court, it can withstand scrutiny “The NBI has its mandate as investigators,” Vida […]...
